answer_1.quote: Our empirical results validate our approach... spanning pairwise, single rating, and classification tasks and various domains (e.g., safety, summarization)...
answer_1.outputs: model responses evaluated for quality, safety, factual consistency, and instruction adherence

answer_2.quote: We propose a comprehensive evaluation suite, with seven pairwise comparison benchmarks, four single rating benchmarks, and two classification benchmarks... For pairwise comparison and classification benchmarks, we report the agreement between judges and human annotators (i.e., accuracy), and for single rating benchmarks, we report Pearson correlation coefficient...

answer_3.quote: Our work aims to train foundational judge models: Judges that accommodate flexible evaluation criteria, perform various evaluation tasks, and handle diverse evaluation domains... we train our judges to perform four evaluation tasks: Single-instance rating, pairwise comparison, binary classification, and response deduction.
